title: Agentic RCA for Internet-Scale Services Using Constrained Creativity

paragraphs.en: System administrators of Internet-scale services need to resolve failure incidents to maintain reliability of such services. Ideally, we want a troubleshooting system to be: (1) expressive to known and unknown incidents with high accuracy; (2) cost efficient at scale; (3) explainable to provide actionable insights operators can act on; and (4) entail low effort from the operators. Unfortunately, most existing systems, including emerging LLM-assisted agentic workflows and structured frameworks for authoring diverse RCA algorithms fall short of achieving all four requirements. We present E4, a novel agentic system for troubleshooting for Internet-scale services. E4 embodies the paradigm of constrained creativity that combines the best of LLM-assisted automation and exploration with the explainability and efficiency of a structured approach. Instead of allowing an LLM agent to write arbitrary code or generate arbitrary responses, we provide the agent a restricted DSL to generate its response via simple loop-free data flow programs. This DSL, equipped with high level operators for troubleshooting, makes E4’s output accurate, verifiable and explainable. On a mix of synthetic and real-world workloads, E4 achieves up to 62 % 62\% better accuracy compared to state-of-the-art solutions, while providing more explainable responses at up to 12 × 12\times reduced cost.
paragraphs.zh: 互联网级服务的系统管理员需要解决故障事件，以维持此类服务的可靠性。 理想情况下，我们希望一个故障排除系统能够：(1) 以高准确性描述已知和未知的故障事件；(2) 在大规模应用时具备成本效益；(3) 具备可解释性，以便提供操作员可以采取行动的实用见解；以及 (4) 使操作员付出的努力尽可能少。 遗憾的是，大多数现有系统，包括新兴的 LLM 辅助智能体工作流程和用于编写多样化根本原因分析算法的结构化框架，都无法满足上述全部四个要求。 我们提出了 E4，一个用于互联网级服务故障排除的新型智能体系统。 E4 体现了“受约束创造力”这一范式，它将 LLM 辅助自动化与探索的优势，同结构化方法的可解释性和效率相结合。 与其允许 LLM 智能体编写任意代码或生成任意响应，我们为其提供了一个受限的领域特定语言（DSL），使其通过简单的无循环数据流程序生成响应。 该 DSL 配备了用于故障排除的高级操作符，使得 E4 的输出既准确、可验证，又具备可解释性。 在合成和真实世界混合工作负载中，E4 的准确性相比当前最先进的解决方案最高提升了 62%（62\%），同时以最多降低 12 倍（12 × 12\times）的成本提供了更具解释性的响应。

paragraphs.en: Modern Internet services handle millions of clients in diverse and heterogeneous Internet conditions today. Providers running such services care about key performance indicators or KPIs (e.g., web page load time, latency, buffering) affecting user experience. To this end, they constantly monitor and troubleshoot their systems to track and optimize these KPIs. Given the dynamic operating environment and heterogeneity of clients, drops in KPIs are the norm, not the exception. When such KPI-impacting incidents occur, operators need root cause analysis or troubleshooting workflows to identify what caused the incident and initiate mitigations.
paragraphs.zh: 如今的现代互联网服务需要在多样化且异构的互联网条件下处理数百万客户端。 运行此类服务的提供商关注关键绩效指标（KPI）（例如，网页加载时间、延迟、缓冲），这些指标会影响用户体验。 为此，他们会持续监控和排查系统问题，以跟踪并优化这些 KPI。 鉴于动态的运行环境和客户端的异构性，KPI 的下降是常态而非例外。 当发生此类影响 KPI 的事件时，运营人员需要根因分析或故障排除流程，以确定事件原因并启动缓解措施。

paragraphs.en: We present E4, an agentic system for root causing incidents in Internet-scale services that demonstrates it is possible to simultaneously achieve all four requirements. Our work builds on constrained creativity [ 55 ] , a recently proposed design paradigm for agents in systems operations. Instead of having an LLM generate arbitrary code or explore arbitrary hypotheses, we constrain the creativity of the LLM to only produce programs in a structured functional form using a specific DSL. Domain experts can provide an initial library of operators and diagnostic workflows expressed as dataflow DAGs for different kinds of incidents that may occur. The agentic system still has the freedom to reason when its library or playbooks are insufficient and dynamically create new operators and DAGs. Figure 1 previews our results: E4 combines higher average diagnostic accuracy with lower average cost than the evaluated baselines.

paragraphs.en: There are three key challenges to translate this high-level idea into practice(§ 4 ): (1) bootstrapping the operator library for a new domain; (2) resolving a new incident efficiently and explainably; and (3) evolving the operator library to tackle future issues. For (1), rather than use a generic domain- and deployment-agnostic library, we develop an effective heuristic to agentically adapt to the available telemetry types and data fields in a new deployment. For (2), rather than use a naive spray-and-pray approach and launching multiple parallel agents, we employ a diagnostic approach that runs analysis via progressive stages of expressivity, moving to the next stage only if the previous stage was insufficient. Finally, for (3), rather than naively allowing the agent to arbitrarily extend the operator library, we explicitly gate the admission of new operators based on their demonstrable utility to explain novel incidents.
paragraphs.zh: 将这一高层理念转化为实践（§ 4）存在三个关键挑战：(1) 为新领域启动操作符库；(2) 高效且可解释地解决新事件；以及 (3) 演进操作符库以应对未来问题。 针对 (1)，我们并未使用通用的、与领域和部署无关的库，而是开发了一种有效的启发式方法，使智能体能够自适应新部署中可用的遥测类型和数据字段。 针对 (2)，我们并未采用简单的“广撒网”方法并启动多个并行智能体，而是采用一种诊断方法，通过逐步提升表达力的阶段进行分析，仅在前一阶段不足时才会进入下一阶段。 最后，针对 (3)，我们并未简单允许智能体随意扩展操作符库，而是明确基于新操作符在解释新型事件方面的可验证效用，来控制其引入。

paragraphs.en: We develop a practical end-to-end prototype of E4. We develop an initial library of core operators and example playbooks for common incident types. We design a systematic methodology for hypothesis generation, pruning, and scoring. We evaluate this prototype on a mix of real-world and synthetic incidents based on data from a large application analytics provider, including a small pilot study on real incidents. We find that E4 can be up to 62 % 62\% more accurate than the strongest baseline agentic system in terms of identifying the root causes within the top-3 suggested leads, and 5.4 × 5.4\times cheaper on average, and up to 12 × 12\times cheaper, in terms of total analysis cost. We run a number of factor analysis studies and find that the use of the abstraction in constrained creativity is the key contributor. We show that E4 can be effective even with lower reasoning models. We also demonstrate that E4 is flexible and that its effectiveness can be amplified via analyst hints and predefined playbooks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一个实用的 E4 端到端原型。 我们为常见事件类型开发了一个初始的核心算子库和示例剧本库。 我们设计了一种系统化的假设生成、剪枝和评分方法。 我们基于某大型应用分析提供商的数据，在真实事件和合成事件的混合数据集上对该原型进行了评估，其中也包括对真实事件的小规模试点研究。 我们发现，在识别前 3 个建议线索中的根本原因方面，E4 的准确性最高可比最强的基线智能体系统高出 62%（62\%），平均成本更低 5.4 倍（5.4\times），总分析成本最高可降低 12 倍（12\times）。 我们进行了一系列因素分析研究，发现受约束创造力中抽象概念的使用是主要贡献因素。 我们证明了即使使用推理能力较弱的模型，E4 仍然有效。 我们还证明了 E4 具有灵活性，并且通过分析师提示和预定义剧本可以进一步提升其有效性。

sents.en: We evaluate this prototype on a mix of real-world and synthetic incidents based on data from a large application analytics provider, including a small pilot study on real incidents.
sents.zh: 我们基于某大型应用分析提供商的数据，在真实事件和合成事件的混合数据集上对该原型进行了评估，其中也包括对真实事件的小规模试点研究。

sents.en: We find that E4 can be up to 62 % 62\% more accurate than the strongest baseline agentic system in terms of identifying the root causes within the top-3 suggested leads, and 5.4 × 5.4\times cheaper on average, and up to 12 × 12\times cheaper, in terms of total analysis cost.
sents.zh: 我们发现，在识别前 3 个建议线索中的根本原因方面，E4 的准确性最高可比最强的基线智能体系统高出 62%（62\%），平均成本更低 5.4 倍（5.4\times），总分析成本最高可降低 12 倍（12\times）。

sents.en: We run a number of factor analysis studies and find that the use of the abstraction in constrained creativity is the key contributor.
sents.zh: 我们进行了一系列因素分析研究，发现受约束创造力中抽象概念的使用是主要贡献因素。

sents.en: We show that E4 can be effective even with lower reasoning models.
sents.zh: 我们证明了即使使用推理能力较弱的模型，E4 仍然有效。

sents.en: We also demonstrate that E4 is flexible and that its effectiveness can be amplified via analyst hints and predefined playbooks.
sents.zh: 我们还证明了 E4 具有灵活性，并且通过分析师提示和预定义剧本可以进一步提升其有效性。

paragraphs.en: Setting We consider an RCA assistant that runs alongside an existing alerting system. Given an alert that specifies a KPI anomaly (and its baseline/anomalous time windows), the assistant analyzes available telemetry data and returns a rank-ordered set of hypotheses (e.g., a client cohort, backend service, user behavior sequence) with supporting evidence. The assistant can run fully autonomously from the alert alone, or accept an analyst hint that can prioritize a class of hypotheses and suggest how to probe them.

paragraphs.en: Example 1 (Figure 3(a) ): In this case, the KPI of interest to the provider is the login failure rate. An alert fires that the login failure rate went up. The root-cause of the problem is that clients belonging to a specific region were suffering higher failures. The analyst used a traditional distributional shift analysis. Here, for each distinct cohort identified by client attribute values, they check if the distribution of login failures in recent times changed significantly and identify top-5 cohorts that changed the most. Unfortunately, this not only missed the true root cause but also produced false leads. In this case, true problem cohort exhibited a change in the distribution with high variance much before the incident which eventually got amplified when the alert fired. Ideally, the system should also consider such second order effects on distribution properties or frequency-based analysis .
paragraphs.zh: 示例 1（图 3(a)）：在这种情况下，提供商关注的关键绩效指标是登录失败率。 系统发出警报，提示登录失败率有所上升。 问题的根本原因是属于特定地区的客户端遭遇了更高的失败率。 分析师使用了一种传统的分布偏移分析方法。 在此，对于通过客户端属性值识别出的每个独立群体，他们检查近期登录失败的分布是否发生了显著变化，并找出变化最明显的五个主要群体。 遗憾的是，这种方法不仅未能发现真正的根本原因，还产生了错误的线索。 在这种情况下，真正存在问题的群体在事件发生之前很久就表现出分布变化和高方差，而这一变化在警报触发时最终被放大。 理想情况下，系统还应考虑此类对分布属性或基于频率的分析产生的二阶影响。

paragraphs.en: Example 2 (Figure 3(b) ) In this example, the provider was trying to diagnose a sudden increase in the client checkout errors. But they could not find any discernible error or timeout patterns in backend logs or the client side logs. The true cause turned out to be subtle. There was a policy update where users using a specific “buy now pay later” scheme were no longer allowed to use discount/coupon codes. Users who used this specific payment option after applying the coupon code encountered checkout errors. Other users using different payment modes or who did not apply the coupon did not face issues. In this case, we need to look deeper into behavioral “event sequence patterns” (e.g., Coupon followed by PayLater) that led to errors.
paragraphs.zh: 示例 2（图 3(b)）在此示例中，提供方试图诊断客户端结账错误突然增加的问题。 但他们无法在后台日志或客户端日志中发现任何明显的错误或超时模式。 真正的原因实际上非常隐蔽。 有一项策略更新规定，使用特定“先买后付”方案的用户不再被允许使用折扣/优惠券代码。 在使用优惠券代码后选择这种特定支付选项的用户遇到了结账错误。 使用其他支付方式或未使用优惠券的其他用户则没有遇到问题。 在这种情况下，我们需要更深入地分析导致错误的行为“事件序列模式”（例如，“优惠券”之后紧接着“先买后付”）。

paragraphs.en: Example 3 (Figure 3(c) ): In a third example, the provider was concerned about client-perceived latency. An alert fires on an end-to-end latency KPI. The true root cause was that one of the backend services handling client requests was flapping and its service response time caused clients assigned to it to suffer. The analyst relied on a traditional “correlation” approach to look for backend services whose average response time during the incident duration was high and identified the top-5 services. Unfortunately, these were all false leads and missed the true problem. If the analyst had some intuition that flapping could explain it, they would like to dynamically craft a new hypothesis focused on identifying instability-focused tests that rank services by the change in coefficient of variation.
paragraphs.zh: 示例 3（图 3(c)）：在第三个示例中，提供者担心客户端感知到的延迟问题。 针对端到端延迟关键绩效指标触发了警报。 真正的根本原因是，处理客户端请求的其中一个后端服务出现了波动，其服务响应时间导致分配给该服务的客户端受到影响。 分析师采用传统的“相关性”方法，寻找在事件发生期间平均响应时间较高的后端服务，并确定了排名前五的服务。 遗憾的是，这些线索都是错误的，未能发现真正的问题所在。 如果分析师能够凭直觉判断服务波动可能是原因，他们就会希望动态构建一个新的假设，专注于识别以不稳定性为焦点的测试，通过变异系数的变化对服务进行排序。

paragraphs.en: Requirements The above examples help us identify four key requirements for any automated system for RCA in Internet-scale services:
paragraphs.zh: 需求 上述示例有助于我们确定任何用于互联网级服务的自动根本原因分析（RCA）系统的四项关键需求：

paragraphs.en: Expressive: Our examples show the need to consider a diverse set of hypotheses that can span client-side attributes, event patterns, backend metrics, and so on. They also highlight that we may need to look beyond rigid statistical tests or heuristics to avoid blind spots and false leads.
paragraphs.zh: 表达性：我们的示例表明，有必要考虑一组多样化的假设，这些假设可以涵盖客户端属性、事件模式、后端指标等等。 它们还强调，为了避免盲点和错误线索，我们可能需要超越僵化的统计检验或经验法则。

sents.en: Expressive: Our examples show the need to consider a diverse set of hypotheses that can span client-side attributes, event patterns, backend metrics, and so on.
sents.zh: 表达性：我们的示例表明，有必要考虑一组多样化的假设，这些假设可以涵盖客户端属性、事件模式、后端指标等等。

sents.en: They also highlight that we may need to look beyond rigid statistical tests or heuristics to avoid blind spots and false leads.
sents.zh: 它们还强调，为了避免盲点和错误线索，我们可能需要超越僵化的统计检验或经验法则。

paragraphs.en: Efficient: At the same time, we cannot do a brute force search over all possible hypothesis or comb through all data. Both cost and responsiveness of incident resolution are critical and we should be able to get to resolution or a set of leads quickly and cost effectively.
paragraphs.zh: 高效性：同时，我们无法对所有可能的假设进行暴力搜索，也无法逐一排查所有数据。 事件处理的成本与响应速度都至关重要，我们应该能够以快速且经济有效的方式达成解决或获得一系列线索。

sents.en: Efficient: At the same time, we cannot do a brute force search over all possible hypothesis or comb through all data.
sents.zh: 高效性：同时，我们无法对所有可能的假设进行暴力搜索，也无法逐一排查所有数据。

sents.en: Both cost and responsiveness of incident resolution are critical and we should be able to get to resolution or a set of leads quickly and cost effectively.
sents.zh: 事件处理的成本与响应速度都至关重要，我们应该能够以快速且经济有效的方式达成解决或获得一系列线索。

paragraphs.en: Explainable: The examples involve non-trivial reasoning beyond basic heuristics and second-order effects. In this case, the analysis should be explainable, so that its outputs are actionable. Imagine a blackbox system that states an answer or produces a long python notebook. Even if it was correct, the analyst would be uneasy to take the recommendation on face value.
paragraphs.zh: 可解释性：这些示例涉及超越基本启发式方法和二阶效应的非简单推理。 在这种情况下，分析过程应当具备可解释性，以便其输出具有可操作性。 想象一个黑箱系统，它给出一个答案或生成一个冗长的 Python 笔记本。 即使结果正确，分析师也不会轻易接受这一建议而不加质疑。

sents.en: Explainable: The examples involve non-trivial reasoning beyond basic heuristics and second-order effects.
sents.zh: 可解释性：这些示例涉及超越基本启发式方法和二阶效应的非简单推理。

sents.en: In this case, the analysis should be explainable, so that its outputs are actionable.
sents.zh: 在这种情况下，分析过程应当具备可解释性，以便其输出具有可操作性。

sents.zh: 即使结果正确，分析师也不会轻易接受这一建议而不加质疑。

paragraphs.en: Effort: The system should be easy to use by practitioners, so they do not deal with complex notebooks and writing Pandas/SQL queries. Furthermore, human analysts may want to see the output of AI algorithms and refine them based on their domain knowledge and steer the system or give it hints based on their domain knowledge (e.g., about service flapping in Example 3).
paragraphs.zh: 易用性：该系统应便于从业者使用，使他们无需处理复杂的笔记本和编写 Pandas/SQL 查询。 此外，人类分析师可能希望查看 AI 算法的输出结果，并根据其领域知识对其进行优化，或者基于其领域知识引导系统或提供提示（例如，关于示例 3 中的服务波动问题）。

paragraphs.en: Troubleshooting and RCA are well studied in academia and industry. At a high level, we can categorize existing efforts into one of three classes as shown in Table 1 (with LLM-assisted agents having two subclasses).

paragraphs.en: Specialized algorithms: Conventional RCA approaches use custom algorithms for different types of incidents in client-side and backend services (e.g., [ 14 , 24 , 45 , 33 , 5 , 7 , 73 , 56 , 68 ] ). While they are mostly explainable and efficient, they have two fundamental gaps in terms of expressivity and effort—limited in the types of incidents they can cover and effort to develop the algorithm.
paragraphs.zh: 专用算法：传统的根因分析（RCA）方法针对客户端和后端服务中不同类型的故障，使用了专门的算法（例如，[ 14 , 24 , 45 , 33 , 5 , 7 , 73 , 56 , 68 ] ）。 尽管这些方法大多具备可解释性和高效性，但在表达能力和开发成本方面存在两个根本性的不足——它们所能覆盖的故障类型有限，且算法的开发需要投入大量精力。

paragraphs.en: Structured frameworks for data analytics/RCA workflows: In addition to bespoke algorithms for narrow incident classes, frameworks allow analysts to author new troubleshooting workflows (e.g., [ 52 , 39 , 58 ] ). ExplainIt! [ 31 ] provides a declarative SQL interface for exploring and ranking candidate causes in time-series data. MoCE [ 23 ] expresses hypothesis exploration as operator DAGs and reuses computation across analyses. These frameworks provide flexible, structured analyses, but analysts still supply the queries, workflows, or new analysis methods needed to cover diverse incidents. E4 builds on this approach by using LLMs to compose analysis DAGs and synthesize new operators when needed.

paragraphs.en: LLM-assisted RCA agents: Recent efforts use LLMs to guide diagnosis and gather evidence through tools [ 65 , 61 , 51 , 29 , 67 ] . Workflow-guided agents constrain investigations using predefined procedures [ 48 , 17 , 37 , 41 ] , making the analysis easier to follow but limiting its expressivity. Coding agents can introduce new analyses on demand, but their generated code and reasoning trails can be difficult to inspect. A second, and related issue is efficiency. The LLM may hallucinate and/or chase a number of dead ends, consuming time/tokens in the process [ 35 ] . LLM-assisted agents also repeatedly examine telemetry and intermediate results, incurring substantial token costs. Finally, even with tool augmentation we observe that state-of-the-art (public) capabilities are quite limited in terms of effectiveness [ 61 , 50 , 60 , 9 ] .

paragraphs.en: Takeaways: We see that none of the current paradigms of RCA/troubleshooting efforts can simultaneously achieve all of our requirements. Each class achieves only a subset of these requirements at the expense of the others; an ideal solution would satisfy all four simultaneously. Next, we discuss how we can indeed achieve this in practice.

paragraphs.en: Every analysis in an RCA system can ultimately be thought of as a data analysis program. The program takes the telemetry data, associated metadata, and the anomalous KPI as input, and outputs a ranked list of root cause leads. We posit that high expressivity, explainability, and efficiency are desirable traits of this program, and that an RCA system should produce it with low effort.
paragraphs.zh: RCA 系统中的每一次分析，最终都可以被看作一个数据分析程序。 该程序以遥测数据、相关元数据和异常 KPI 作为输入，输出一个按优先级排序的根因线索列表。 我们认为，高表达力、可解释性和效率是该程序的理想特性，而一个 RCA 系统应当能够轻松生成这样的程序。

sents.zh: RCA 系统中的每一次分析，最终都可以被看作一个数据分析程序。

paragraphs.en: To achieve low-effort, we adopt an LLM-driven RCA system similar to prior work. That said, there is a wide spectrum of how we can use an LLM. Different approaches in agentic RCA systems have different levels of expressivity and explainability on a expressivity–explainability spectrum as shown in Figure 4 . At the expressivity end are general-purpose coding agents, which can write any program. Close to this end, RCAgent [ 61 ] and the agent framework evaluated in OpenRCA [ 65 ] enable flexible tool use and code generation, making their programs expressive but hard to explain. Moving toward greater explainability, works like Flow-of-Action [ 48 ] follow previously created SOP-guided investigation with some procedure generation. At the explainability end are works that only execute human-authored troubleshooting guides, such as LLexus [ 37 ] and StepFly [ 41 ] , where the procedure is fixed in advance and the agent’s role is limited to carrying out its steps.
paragraphs.zh: 为实现低努力度，我们采用了一种与先前研究类似的、由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的根本原因分析（RCA）系统。 尽管如此，LLM 的使用方式仍存在广泛差异。 智能体式 RCA 系统中的不同方法在表达性与可解释性光谱上具有不同的表达性与可解释性水平，如图 4 所示。 在表达性的一端是通用编程智能体，它们能够编写任何程序。 靠近这一端的有 RCAgent [61] 和 OpenRCA [65] 中评估的智能体框架，它们支持灵活的工具使用和代码生成，使其编写的程序具有高度表达性，但难以解释。 向更高可解释性方向发展的研究，如 Flow-of-Action [48]，则遵循预先创建并由标准作业程序（SOP）引导的调查流程，并包含部分程序生成。 在可解释性的一端是那些仅执行人类编写的故障排除指南的研究，例如 LLexus [37] 和 StepFly [41]，其中流程是预先固定的，智能体的角色仅限于执行既定步骤。

paragraphs.en: To navigate this tradeoff, we adopt constrained creativity [ 55 ] , a paradigm in which the programs an agent produces stay within a bounded region of this expressivity–explainability spectrum. More specifically, we constrain the structure that every analysis program must follow using a specific domain-specific language (DSL). As illustrated in fig. 4 , the DSL and operator library restricts the space of programs that can be generated to perform the analysis. In essence, we can think of each RCA analysis as a composition of some basic lego blocks or operators that retrieve or analyze the telemetry data, prune the space of related entities, construct the trajectories, and perform some statistical or contrastive analysis to produce leads. Said differently, our DSL defines a vocabulary of callable operator APIs, such as generating candidate hypotheses or scoring them, and a grammar requiring that calls to these APIs compose into an analysis DAG. The grammar is fixed, so every analysis program obeys the same structural rules. This structure also helps keep token and execution costs low (§ 4.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了应对这种权衡，我们采用了受约束的创造力 [55]，这是一种范式，其中智能体生成的程序会保持在表达性与可解释性光谱的一个有限区域内。 更具体地说，我们通过一种特定的领域特定语言（DSL）来约束每个分析程序必须遵循的结构。 如图 4 所示，DSL 和算子库将可用于执行分析的程序的生成空间限制在了一个有限的范围内。 本质上，我们可以将每次根本原因分析（RCA）视为由一些基本的乐高积木或算子组合而成，这些积木或算子负责获取或分析遥测数据、缩小相关实体的范围、构建轨迹，并执行一些统计或对比分析以生成线索。 换言之，我们的 DSL 定义了一组可调用算子 API 的词汇表（例如生成候选假设或对其进行评分），以及一套语法规则，要求对这些 API 的调用必须组合成一个分析有向无环图（DAG）。 该语法规则是固定的，因此每个分析程序都必须遵循相同的结构规则。 这种结构还有助于保持较低的令牌和运行成本（§4.2）。

paragraphs.en: Realizing this paradigm raises four questions: how to represent the structure that every analysis program must follow; what vocabulary that structure can use, and where it comes from; how to keep the cost of an investigation in check; and what to do when the vocabulary does not suffice. We answer these in the following sections.

paragraphs.en: Relation to harness engineering Skills and harness engineering decide what the agent can call, how calls compose, and what executes. Harness design has grown from prompt templates into runtime and systems design [ 62 ] , spanning workflows [ 27 ] , evaluation, permission control, state management, and review loops [ 54 ] . For RCA, constrained creativity can serve as the basis for designing a good harness based on its DSL in conjunction with these techniques.

paragraphs.en: We present E4, a practical realization of this high-level idea of constrained creativity. To fix the grammar every analysis program must follow, we borrow the DAG structure of a recent work [ 23 ] . E4 ships with an initial set of operators common to RCA in Internet-scale services; this vocabulary can be extended during the investigation of an incident. E4 follows a two-step exploration process of the given region of expressivity–explainability spectrum. At level 1 – the DSL has a given vocabulary and grammar and E4 is restricted to use the given vocabulary and grammar to explore the space of all possible analysis programs and come up with the best that solves the anlysis. At level 2, the vocabulary can be evolved using an LLM, thereby increasing the space of programs more towards the space of all programs supported by the DSL’s grammar. These two steps are analogous to the two levels in fig. 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 E4，这是这一高级别“受约束创造力”理念的实际实现。 为了确定所有分析程序必须遵循的语法规则，我们借鉴了近期一项研究 [23] 中的 DAG 结构。 E4 附带了一套适用于互联网规模服务的 RCA 通用初始算子集；在事件调查过程中，这套词汇表可以进一步扩展。 E4 遵循一个两步探索过程，用于探索给定的表达性–可解释性光谱区域。 在第一层级中，DSL 具有既定的词汇表和语法规则，E4 只能使用这些既定词汇和语法来探索所有可能分析程序的空间，并找出能够解决该分析问题的最佳方案。 在第二层级中，可以通过 LLM 演化词汇表，从而将程序空间进一步扩展至 DSL 语法所支持的所有程序空间。 这两个步骤与图 4 中的两个层级相对应。

sents.en: At level 1 – the DSL has a given vocabulary and grammar and E4 is restricted to use the given vocabulary and grammar to explore the space of all possible analysis programs and come up with the best that solves the anlysis.
sents.zh: 在第一层级中，DSL 具有既定的词汇表和语法规则，E4 只能使用这些既定词汇和语法来探索所有可能分析程序的空间，并找出能够解决该分析问题的最佳方案。

sents.en: At level 2, the vocabulary can be evolved using an LLM, thereby increasing the space of programs more towards the space of all programs supported by the DSL’s grammar.
sents.zh: 在第二层级中，可以通过 LLM 演化词汇表，从而将程序空间进一步扩展至 DSL 语法所支持的所有程序空间。

sents.zh: 这两个步骤与图 4 中的两个层级相对应。

paragraphs.en: Bootstrap runs once per deployment and fixes the vocabulary the agent starts from, and with it the program space of fig. 4 that level 1 explores. The LLM takes as input the initial operators and example playbooks, the deployment’s telemetry schema, a description of the RCA task, and optional analyst hints. From these it generates additional operators from the schema and domain knowledge of the task, then composes example playbooks over them. New operators must use input and output types supported by the DSL; the grammar remains fixed. The LLM sees the schema but never the deployment’s telemetry. The playbooks undergo static verification and execution on synthetic data generated from the schema to catch runtime errors. Bootstrap hands the agent a deployment-specific operator library and verified playbooks for use at runtime.
paragraphs.zh: 引导程序在每次部署时运行一次，并确定智能体开始使用的词汇表，以及图4中第1级所探索的程序空间。 大型语言模型（LLM）的输入包括初始算子、示例剧本、部署的遥测模式、RCA任务的描述以及可选的分析员提示。 基于这些输入，它会从模式和任务领域知识中生成额外的算子，然后基于这些算子组合出示例剧本。 新算子必须使用领域特定语言（DSL）支持的输入和输出类型；其语法保持固定不变。 大型语言模型（LLM）可以看到遥测模式，但绝不会看到部署的遥测数据本身。 这些剧本会经过静态验证，并在基于遥测模式生成的合成数据上执行，以发现运行时错误。 引导程序会将特定于该部署的算子库和已验证的剧本交给智能体，供其在运行时使用。

paragraphs.en: Runtime adaptation runs per incident, at level 1 of fig. 4 . The agent is given the incident as a natural-language description, relevant metadata, and optional troubleshooting hints, along with the operator library and playbooks from bootstrap and access to the telemetry. It selects a playbook or composes a new DAG from the operators. The verifier checks that the referenced operators exist, connected operators have compatible types, and the graph is acyclic. Once verified, the DAG is passed to the execution engine, which schedules its database and compute operations. The agent can revise the DAG over several iterations to refine the diagnosis, and returns a ranked list of root cause leads; if no program over the current vocabulary yields a satisfactory result, it escalates to evolution.
paragraphs.zh: 每次事件都会运行运行时自适应，对应图4中的第1级。 智能体接收以自然语言描述的事件、相关元数据和可选的故障排除提示，以及来自启动过程的算子库和剧本，并能访问遥测数据。 它会选择一个剧本，或从现有算子中组合出一个新的有向无环图（DAG）。 验证器会检查所引用的算子是否存在、相连的算子类型是否兼容，以及该图是否为无环图。 验证通过后，该有向无环图会被传递给执行引擎，由其安排数据库和计算操作。 智能体可以在多次迭代中修改该有向无环图以优化诊断结果，并返回一个按优先级排序的根因候选列表；如果当前词汇表中的任何程序都无法得出令人满意的结果，则会升级到演化阶段。

paragraphs.en: Evolution runs when runtime adaptation escalates, moving the agent to level 2 of fig. 4 and enlarging the space of programs it can compose ( fig. 4 ). The LLM is given the escalated incident together with the history of failed attempts, the current operator library and playbooks, and the task description. It proposes new operators, with input and output types supported by the DSL, that fill the gap the failures reveal, and composes playbooks over them; the grammar remains fixed. The extended library is admitted only if it lets the escalated incident be served, in which case it replaces the current one and is reused in subsequent investigations; otherwise the library is left unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 当运行时自适应升级时，演化过程便会启动，将智能体推进至图 4 中的第 2 级，并扩大其可组合的程序空间（图 4）。 LLM 会获得升级后的事件、失败尝试的历史记录、当前的算子库和剧本，以及任务描述。 它会提出新的算子——这些算子的输入和输出类型受 DSL 支持——以填补失败所暴露的空白，并基于它们组合剧本；语法本身保持不变。 只有当扩展后的算子库能够处理升级后的事件时，它才会被采纳；此时它将取代当前算子库并在后续调查中重复使用，否则算子库将保持原样。

paragraphs.en: This section provides detailed designs of the bootstrap, compose and evolve phases of our RCA agent, E4, for a given deployment. Figure 5 outlines the various components of the end-to-end system. There are 3 core ideas in the design: (1) bootstrapping E4 for a new domain, (2) diagnosing an incident via successive stages of expressivity and (3) evolving the library of operators in the DSL if the current operators are insufficient. We describe these next.
paragraphs.zh: 本节详细介绍了我们 RCA 智能体 E4 在特定部署场景下启动、组合和演化阶段的详细设计。 图 5 概述了端到端系统的各个组成部分。 该设计包含 3 个核心思想：(1) 为全新领域启动 E4，(2) 通过逐步提升表达能力的阶段来诊断事件，以及 (3) 如果当前算子不足，则演化 DSL 中的算子库。接下来我们将对此进行说明。

sents.en: This section provides detailed designs of the bootstrap, compose and evolve phases of our RCA agent, E4, for a given deployment.
sents.zh: 本节详细介绍了我们 RCA 智能体 E4 在特定部署场景下启动、组合和演化阶段的详细设计。

sents.en: Figure 5 outlines the various components of the end-to-end system.
sents.zh: 图 5 概述了端到端系统的各个组成部分。

sents.en: There are 3 core ideas in the design: (1) bootstrapping E4 for a new domain, (2) diagnosing an incident via successive stages of expressivity and (3) evolving the library of operators in the DSL if the current operators are insufficient. We describe these next.
sents.zh: 该设计包含 3 个核心思想：(1) 为全新领域启动 E4，(2) 通过逐步提升表达能力的阶段来诊断事件，以及 (3) 如果当前算子不足，则演化 DSL 中的算子库。接下来我们将对此进行说明。

paragraphs.en: Different internet services have different sets of available monitoring data with varying data schemas. The bootstrapping phase, executed once per deployment, adapts E4 to the specific system, ensuring the DSL includes obvious operators to incorporate domain-knowledge or take advantage of domain-specific columns in the data schema. For instance, in one scenario, the bootstrapping phase produced an operator that uses parent-child relationships in traces to rank services by their failed spans with no failed child, helping distinguish potential error origins from propagated failures.
paragraphs.zh: 不同的互联网服务拥有各不相同的可用监控数据集，且数据模式也各不相同。 启动阶段在每次部署时仅执行一次，它会将 E4 适配到特定系统，确保 DSL 包含明确的算子，以便融入领域知识或利用数据模式中特定的领域列。 例如，在某一场景中，启动阶段生成了一种算子，该算子利用追踪数据中的父子关系，根据服务中无失败子节点的失败跨度对服务进行排序，从而帮助区分潜在的错误来源与传播性故障。

paragraphs.en: For bootstrapping, we start with a starter DSL with an initial set of operators that are general for different modes of telemetry (e.g., timeseries, events, traces). Then we prompt a state-of-the-art coding agent with the following inputs: the initial operator set, the deployment’s telemetry schema and metadata, a natural-language description of the domain and the RCA task, a few example playbooks (pre-defined programs in the DSL) and an optional analyst hint. Based on this input, the agent synthesizes a specialized operator library and a playbook library customized to that deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 为了启动，我们从一个初始 DSL 开始，其中包含一组适用于不同遥测模式（例如时间序列、事件和追踪）的通用算子。 然后，我们用以下输入提示一个最先进的编码智能体：初始算子集、部署的遥测模式和元数据、对领域和根本原因分析任务的自然语言描述、几个示例剧本（DSL 中预定义的程序）以及可选的分析员提示。 基于这些输入，该智能体会合成一个专门针对该部署的算子库和剧本库。

paragraphs.en: The grammar of the DSL constitutes the structure that E4 uses to compose the operators. We fix E4’s grammar to a DAG of operators, but we note that other structures like tree, or a program with loops are also possible. We made this choice as previous RCA algorithms fit naturally into a DAG [ 23 ] 1 1 1 refer to appendix C for the exact DSL grammar . We next describe the starter DSL vocabulary : the initial set of operators provided as input to the bootstrapping phase.
paragraphs.zh: DSL 的语法规则构成了 E4 用于组合算子的结构。 我们将 E4 的语法规则固定为一种算子有向无环图（DAG），但需要指出的是，树状结构或包含循环的程序等其他结构也是可行的。 我们做出这一选择是因为先前的 RCA 算法能够自然地适配有向无环图 [23]；1 1 1 具体 DSL 语法规则请参见附录 C。 接下来我们将介绍初始 DSL 词汇表：即作为引导阶段输入提供的初始算子集合。

paragraphs.en: Candidate generation operators : Operators to analyze (1) data cohorts based on column attributes e.g., region, deviceVersion, (2) event sequences e.g., error sequences in the client-side device, (3) performance metrics e.g., CPU usage in backend services. They output a list of candidate root cause leads.
paragraphs.zh: 候选生成算子：用于分析的算子，包括（1）基于列属性（例如区域、设备版本）的数据群体，（2）事件序列（例如客户端设备中的错误序列），以及（3）性能指标（例如后端服务的 CPU 使用率）。 它们会输出一系列候选根本原因线索。

sents.en: They output a list of candidate root cause leads.
sents.zh: 它们会输出一系列候选根本原因线索。

paragraphs.en: Candidate scoring operators : These include (1) statistical scorers that test a candidate’s metrics against the baseline (e.g., from history or another user cohort) via standard statistical test, (2) Bayesian models, such as decision tree, for learning distribution of metric values in fine-grained data cohorts and performing MLE. They output candidate root cause leads along with a score.
paragraphs.zh: 候选者评分算子：这些包括（1）通过标准统计检验，将候选者的指标与基线（例如来自历史记录或其他用户群体）进行比较的统计评分器；（2）贝叶斯模型，例如决策树，用于学习精细数据群体中指标值的分布并执行最大似然估计（MLE）。 它们会输出候选的根本原因线索以及相应的分数。

paragraphs.en: Summarizer operators : These include (1) ensemble aggregation operator to combine results from multiple algorithms via weighted majority, giving weight to root causes flagged by multiple algorithms (2) weight readjustment operators to distinguish primary root causes from secondary symptoms e.g., by penalizing the scores of upstream backend services that get affected by a failure. They output a ranked list of candidate root-cause leads.
paragraphs.zh: 摘要生成算子：这些包括（1）集成聚合算子，通过加权多数法结合多个算法的结果，赋予被多个算法标记为根本原因的因素以权重；（2）权重重新调整算子，用于区分主要根本原因和次要症状，例如，通过惩罚因故障而受影响的上游后端服务的得分。 它们会输出一个按排名排序的候选根本原因线索列表。

paragraphs.en: If the analysis uses an ensemble of algorithms, the DAG-based DSL naturally avoids duplicate computation across different algorithms by utilizing the same intermediate result for different downstream analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 如果分析使用了算法集成，那么基于有向无环图（DAG）的领域特定语言（DSL）通过为不同的下游分析共享相同的中间结果，自然可以避免不同算法之间的重复计算。

paragraphs.en: E4’s operators abstract away implementation complexity from the agent; it only needs to know the functional signature describing the input/output types of each operator. For instance, the candidate generation operators require issuing complex SQL queries (e.g. to get all events after login-start and before login-end for each user-session) or perform complex stateful computation over the event stream (e.g. to compute if a user is a frequent user or not). Similarly, the scoring operators have complex algorithmic machinery e.g., employing Aho-Corasick data structure to handle “event strings” for finding event patterns. The agent does not need to know or handle any of these complexities, which boosts its serving accuracy and context usage. These operators are also optimized for large-scale data, resulting in better efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: E4 的算子将实现复杂性从智能体中抽象出来；智能体只需了解描述每个算子输入/输出类型的函数签名即可。 例如，候选生成算子需要执行复杂的 SQL 查询（例如，获取每个用户会话中 login-start 之后、login-end 之前的所有事件），或对事件流执行复杂的状态计算（例如，判断用户是否为高频用户）。 类似地，评分算子也包含复杂的算法机制，例如使用 Aho-Corasick 数据结构来处理“事件字符串”以查找事件模式。 智能体无需了解或处理这些复杂性，这提升了其服务准确率和上下文利用率。 这些算子还针对大规模数据进行了优化，从而实现了更高的效率。

We describe the first two stages below:

paragraphs.en: Stage (1) Fixed playbook : the E4 agent picks an existing playbook from the set of given playbooks for performing RCA and instantiates its hyperparameters for the given incident. For instance, the agent can select a playbook to analyze client cohorts and look for corresponding root causes e.g., browser version, operating system, backend service. If the root cause is not among these entities or it is not found using the chosen playbook, the agent moves to the next stage.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段（1）固定剧本：E4 智能体从给定的剧本集合中选择一个现有剧本来执行根本原因分析（RCA），并为所发生的故障实例化其超参数。 例如，该智能体可以选择一个剧本来分析客户端群体，并查找相应的根本原因，例如浏览器版本、操作系统和后端服务。 如果根本原因不在这些实体中，或者无法通过所选剧本找到，则智能体会进入下一阶段。

sents.en: Specifically, the verifier checks for the following:
sents.zh: 具体而言，该验证器会检查以下内容：

paragraphs.en: operator validity to prevent hallucinated operators
paragraphs.zh: 操作符有效性以防止幻觉操作符

paragraphs.en: type-safety to ensure input/output data types match for each operator in the DAG
paragraphs.zh: 类型安全性，以确保有向无环图（DAG）中每个算子的输入/输出数据类型相匹配

paragraphs.zh: 这些算子通过有向无环图（DAG）组合而成，且不包含任何循环调用。

paragraphs.zh: 候选生成算子仅被评分算子或其他候选生成算子消耗，且没有任何算子未被使用

paragraphs.zh: 该程序最终会得出唯一的一个答案

paragraphs.en: The runtime system is responsible for scheduling all the database and compute operations of the generated DAG, parallelizing them across a distributed cluster. Note that the DAG operations can be of different types e.g., SQL, ML inference, stateful filtering. The runtime also caches intermediate computation to save execution costs, indexing a DAG node by computing a recursive hash of its resolved inputs. This cached result can be resued if the agent invokes the same subgraph in a later analysis. It can also be used for failure recovery in case one of the parallel nodes fails mid-execution. E4 allows the user to change the maximum size of this cache along with the cache eviction policy e.g., Least recently used or Last in first out.
paragraphs.zh: 运行时系统负责调度所生成 DAG 的所有数据库和计算操作，并在分布式集群中实现并行化。 请注意，DAG 操作可能属于不同类型，例如 SQL、ML 推理和状态保留过滤。 运行时系统还会缓存中间计算结果以节省执行成本，并通过计算已解析输入的递归哈希值来为 DAG 节点建立索引。 如果智能体在后续分析中调用相同的子图，该缓存结果可以被重新使用。 在某个并行节点在执行过程中发生故障时，该缓存结果也可用于故障恢复。 E4 允许用户更改此缓存的最大大小以及缓存淘汰策略，例如最近最少使用或先进先出。

paragraphs.en: Note that at no stage does the LLM interact with data directly. The agent reads the prompt, the operator descriptions and the playbook library and produces a DAG. The DAG gets executed in a local environment without any agent interactions. This has two advantages. Firstly, this results in low token costs without sacrificing the accuracy of the analysis (§ 6.2 ). Secondly, this naturally addresses sovereignty and privacy , if any, for sensitive and proprietary data as no data needs to leave the enterprise.
paragraphs.zh: 请注意，在整个过程中，大型语言模型都不会直接与数据交互。 智能体读取提示、操作符描述和策略库，然后生成一个有向无环图（DAG）。 该有向无环图在本地环境中执行，且无需任何与智能体的交互。这有两个优势。 首先，这种方式不会降低分析准确性（§ 6.2），同时还能减少令牌成本。 其次，对于敏感和专有数据，由于没有任何数据需要离开企业，这种方法自然解决了主权和隐私问题（如有）。

paragraphs.en: When the second stage (flexible playbook, fixed operators) of the agent also fails, it implies no program over the current vocabulary (operator library) could diagnose the incident, and the operator library must be extended. This represents stage (3) of expressivity (flexible playbook, flexible operators, fixed DSL) in Figure 4 . This step can be thought of as a joint optimization problem (Appendix D ) to generate the most accurate program (P) from E4’s operator library (L) and both P and L are modified alternatively. For synthesizing operators, E4 analyzes diagnosis gaps. It retains new operators only when they improve the diagnosis, avoiding “operator-bloat”.
paragraphs.zh: 当智能体的第二阶段（灵活的剧本、固定的算子）也失败时，这意味着在当前词汇表（算子库）范围内没有任何程序能够诊断该事件，因此必须扩展算子库。 这对应于图 4 中表达力（灵活的剧本、灵活的算子、固定的 DSL）的第（3）阶段。 这一步可以被视为一个联合优化问题（附录 D），旨在从 E4 的算子库（L）中生成最精确的程序（P），并且 P 和 L 会交替进行修改。 为了合成算子，E4 会分析诊断中的缺失环节。 只有当新算子能够提升诊断效果时，它才会保留这些算子，从而避免“算子膨胀”。

paragraphs.en: To evolve the operator library, we take the escalated incident together with the results of every program tried and why it was deemed insufficient and pass them as input to a coding agent. The LLM is prompted to first evaluate the gap , i.e., why previous attempts were insufficient, and then to propose new operators based on this evaluation. The serve phase of E4’s agent is then invoked again, to diagnose the incident using the new operators. Ultimately, the new operators are admitted to the DSL permanently, if they produced the true root cause (decided via user feedback).
paragraphs.zh: 为了演化算子库，我们将升级后的事件与所有已尝试程序的结果及其被判定为不足的原因一并作为输入提供给编码智能体。 我们会提示大型语言模型首先评估其中的差距，即为何之前的尝试不足，然后基于此评估提出新的算子。 接着，E4 智能体的服务阶段会被再次调用，利用这些新算子来诊断该事件。 最终，如果这些新算子能够揭示真正的根本原因（通过用户反馈确定），它们将被永久纳入 DSL。

sents.en: Ultimately, the new operators are admitted to the DSL permanently, if they produced the true root cause (decided via user feedback).

paragraphs.en: As an example, in one incident, the gap evaluation showed that no operator in the library generates root cause candidates corresponding to the endpoint of a request, and asks for suitable operators. The evolve phase, in this case, synthesized two new operators: the first operator emits candidates based on requests’ target endpoint (host and path), filtering out rarely used endpoints. The second operator computes the candidate’s failure rate within a window by a count-weighted mean and standard deviation and scores the candidate by the Wasserstein-2 distance between the baseline and anomalous windows. Both were admitted, taking the library from 19 19 operators to 21 21 . E4’s agent then orchestrates new analysis by using these two operators along with existing cohort-based summarizer operators. This updated analysis produced the right root cause as the top lead: clients in a single geographic region were experiencing high login-failure rates ( 74 % 74\% ).
paragraphs.zh: 例如，在一项事件中，差距评估显示，库中的任何操作符都无法生成与请求端点对应的根本原因候选项，因此需要寻找合适的操作符。 在此情况下，“演化”阶段合成了两个新的操作符：第一个操作符根据请求的目标端点（主机和路径）生成候选项，并过滤掉极少使用的端点。 第二个操作符通过计数加权平均值和标准差计算窗口内候选项的故障率，并利用基线窗口与异常窗口之间的 Wasserstein-2 距离对候选项进行评分。 这两个操作符均被采纳，使库中的操作符数量从 19 个增加到 21 个。 随后，E4 的智能体利用这两个新操作符以及现有的基于群体的摘要操作符，组织新的分析。 这次更新后的分析将正确的根本原因列为首要线索：位于单一地理区域的客户端出现了高登录失败率（74%）。

paragraphs.en: We implement E4 in about 7.5K lines of Python and run the prototype on a single MacBook Pro with an Apple M3 Pro CPU (12 cores: 6 performance and 6 efficiency), 18 GB of unified memory, and macOS. Programs are serialized as JSON: each node names an operator and its inputs, with node identifiers representing dependencies. The execution engine uses Ray tasks/actors [ 43 ] to run independent branches in parallel and caches node outputs for reuse across attempts. Operator admission checks Python syntax, declared signatures and return annotations, and scans the AST for prohibited I/O and dynamic-code constructs; colliding operator names receive new versions. We run Python 3.10 and Ray 2.49. Across all experiments, the LLM is Gemini-3.1-Pro, served remotely through Google Vertex AI; only the operators execute locally.

paragraphs.en: Baselines We compare E4 with three baselines. LLM-only directly analyzes raw telemetry selected using the balanced sampling approach in OpenRCA [ 65 ] . RCA-Agent , also introduced in OpenRCA [ 65 ] , uses two LLM agents: a controller directs the investigation and interprets results, while an executor writes and runs Python code in a persistent Python interpreter. Terminus-2, the agent harness used in the ORCA-bench evaluation [ 19 ] , investigates raw telemetry through an interactive Bash shell. We run all three baselines through the Harbor harness [ 21 ] used by Terminus-2. All baselines receive the same anomaly trigger as E4, including the anomalous KPI and historical/anomalous time windows. They are prompted to return ranked leads using the same JSON schema as E4, enabling evaluation with a shared parser. All baselines use the same underlying LLM (Gemini-3.1-Pro) as E4 (§ 5 ) and are evaluated on the same incidents.

paragraphs.en: E4 configurations We evaluate three variants of E4. All start from a bootstrapped library containing the starter operators, additional operators synthesized by the LLM during bootstrap, and playbooks over these operators. For the open-source benchmarks, we kept the starter operators unchanged throughout the experiments. 3 3 3 Since the DSB dataset was constructed by us, there is a potential confounder where the workload influences design of the starter operators. The other benchmarks provide a complementary evaluation on independent workloads. We refer to the three successive serving attempts as Stages 1, 2, and 3. E4: stage 1 only selects and instantiates an existing playbook (Stage 1; Mode 1.A). E4: stages 1 + 2 additionally permits composition of a new DSL program using existing operators when Stage 1 fails (Stage 2; Mode 1.B). Full E4 further permits synthesis of new operators and composition of a program using the expanded library when Stage 2 fails (Stage 3; level 2).
paragraphs.zh: E4 配置：我们评估了三种 E4 变体。 所有配置都从一个经过引导的库开始，该库包含初始算子、引导阶段由 LLM 合成的额外算子，以及基于这些算子的剧本。 对于开源基准测试，我们在整个实验过程中保持初始算子不变。由于 DSB 数据集是我们构建的，因此存在一个潜在的混淆因素：工作负载可能会影响初始算子的设计。 其他基准测试则提供了针对独立工作负载的补充性评估。 我们将三次连续的服务尝试称为阶段 1、2 和 3。 E4：阶段 1 仅选择和实例化一个现有的剧本（阶段 1；模式 1.A）。 E4：阶段 1 + 2 在阶段 1 失败时，还允许使用现有算子组合一个新的 DSL 程序（阶段 2；模式 1.B）。 完整 E4 在阶段 2 失败时，进一步允许合成新算子，并使用扩展后的库组合一个程序（阶段 3；级别 2）。

sents.en: E4 configurations We evaluate three variants of E4.
sents.zh: E4 配置：我们评估了三种 E4 变体。

sents.en: All start from a bootstrapped library containing the starter operators, additional operators synthesized by the LLM during bootstrap, and playbooks over these operators.
sents.zh: 所有配置都从一个经过引导的库开始，该库包含初始算子、引导阶段由 LLM 合成的额外算子，以及基于这些算子的剧本。

sents.en: For the open-source benchmarks, we kept the starter operators unchanged throughout the experiments. 3 3 3 Since the DSB dataset was constructed by us, there is a potential confounder where the workload influences design of the starter operators.
sents.zh: 对于开源基准测试，我们在整个实验过程中保持初始算子不变。由于 DSB 数据集是我们构建的，因此存在一个潜在的混淆因素：工作负载可能会影响初始算子的设计。

sents.en: The other benchmarks provide a complementary evaluation on independent workloads.
sents.zh: 其他基准测试则提供了针对独立工作负载的补充性评估。

sents.en: We refer to the three successive serving attempts as Stages 1, 2, and 3.
sents.zh: 我们将三次连续的服务尝试称为阶段 1、2 和 3。

sents.en: E4: stage 1 only selects and instantiates an existing playbook (Stage 1; Mode 1.A).
sents.zh: E4：阶段 1 仅选择和实例化一个现有的剧本（阶段 1；模式 1.A）。

sents.en: E4: stages 1 + 2 additionally permits composition of a new DSL program using existing operators when Stage 1 fails (Stage 2; Mode 1.B).
sents.zh: E4：阶段 1 + 2 在阶段 1 失败时，还允许使用现有算子组合一个新的 DSL 程序（阶段 2；模式 1.B）。

sents.en: Full E4 further permits synthesis of new operators and composition of a program using the expanded library when Stage 2 fails (Stage 3; level 2).
sents.zh: 完整 E4 在阶段 2 失败时，进一步允许合成新算子，并使用扩展后的库组合一个程序（阶段 3；级别 2）。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation metrics We use a two-dimensional metric, Accuracy@ k , i k,i , to evaluate iterative RCA: the fraction of incidents where the true root cause appears among the first k k ranked leads in at least one of up to i i attempts. This captures both the number of leads an analyst must inspect per attempt and the opportunities to revise a diagnosis. We report Accuracy@3,3 on DSB and the three OpenRCA deployments, allowing three ranked leads per attempt and three attempts total (the initial attempt plus up to two retries). The Stage 1-only and Stages 1+2 configurations correspond to Accuracy@3,1 and Accuracy@3,2, respectively. For ORCA-bench, we report Recall@5,3: for each window, we take the highest fraction of labeled root causes found among the first five leads in any of up to three attempts, then average across windows. The Stage 1-only and Stages 1+2 configurations use Recall@5,1 and Recall@5,2, respectively. On a retry, the system is prompted to produce a different ranked list of root causes from its previous attempt. Baselines repeat their investigation workflow, while E4 progresses through playbook selection, composition using existing operators, and evolution with newly synthesized operators. We report the total analysis cost, including LLM inference and system costs.
paragraphs.zh: 评估指标：我们使用一个二维指标 Accuracy@k, i k,i 来评估迭代式 RCA：在最多 i 次尝试中，至少有某一次尝试的前 k 个排序线索中包含了真实根本原因的事件所占比例。 这一指标既反映了分析师每次尝试必须检查的线索数量，也体现了修正诊断的机会。 我们在 DSB 和三个 OpenRCA 部署上报告 Accuracy@3,3 的结果，即每次尝试允许三个排序线索，总共允许三次尝试（初始尝试加上最多两次重试）。 仅阶段 1 和阶段 1+2 的配置分别对应 Accuracy@3,1 和 Accuracy@3,2。 对于 ORCA-bench，我们报告 Recall@5,3：对每个窗口，我们取在最多三次尝试中任意一次的前五个线索里找到的已标注根本原因的最高比例，然后对各窗口取平均值。 仅阶段 1 和阶段 1+2 的配置分别使用 Recall@5,1 和 Recall@5,2。 在重试时，系统会被提示生成一个不同于之前尝试的根本原因排序列表。 基线方法会重复其调查流程，而 E4 则会依次进行剧本选择、使用现有操作符进行组合，以及通过新合成的操作符实现演进。 我们报告总分析成本，包括 LLM 推理成本和系统成本。

paragraphs.en: Recipe stage contributions Across the 70 incidents in Market-CB1, Bank, and Telecom, 32 ( 45.7 % 45.7\% ) required Stage 2, and 19 ( 27.1 % 27.1\% ) proceeded to Stage 3. These stages correctly localized an additional 13 and 6 incidents, respectively, beyond the 38 handled by Stage 1. Using the stage values in Figure 6(a) , Stage 2 improves accuracy/recall over Stage 1 by 41.6 % 41.6\% on average across all five datasets, averaging per-dataset relative gains. Stage 3 improves accuracy/recall over Stage 2 by 7 % 7\% under the same averaging convention; on Bank, this gain is 17 % 17\% .
paragraphs.zh: 在 Market-CB1、Bank 和 Telecom 中发生的 70 起事件中，有 32 起（45.7%）需要第 2 阶段，另有 19 起（27.1%）进入了第 3 阶段。 这些阶段分别正确定位了另外 13 起和 6 起事件，超出了第 1 阶段处理的 38 起事件。 使用图 6(a) 中的阶段值，在所有五个数据集上平均计算各数据集的相对增益后，第 2 阶段的准确率/召回率相比第 1 阶段平均提升了 41.6%。 在相同的平均计算规则下，第 3 阶段的准确率/召回率相比第 2 阶段提升了 7%；在 Bank 数据集中，这一提升幅度为 17%。

paragraphs.en: We illustrate findings from our evaluation datasets through examples of how E4 prepares its operator library, reuses playbooks in Stage 1, composes new analyses in Stage 2, and synthesizes new operators in Stage 3.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过示例展示了我们评估数据集的发现，这些示例说明了 E4 如何准备其算子库、在第一阶段重用剧本、在第二阶段组合新的分析，以及在第三阶段合成新的算子。

paragraphs.en: In Market-CB1, an incident flagged increased average latency at the product-catalog service. In Stage 1, E4 selected an existing metric-shift playbook, which compared component metrics against historical baselines and combined evidence across abnormal series. It ranked a shipping-service instance first and identified excessive read I/O, matching the ground truth fault without composing a new DAG or synthesizing an operator.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Market-CB1 中，一起事件提示产品目录服务的平均延迟有所增加。 在第一阶段，E4 选择了一个现有的指标偏移剧本，该剧本将组件指标与历史基线进行比较，并结合异常序列中的证据进行分析。 它将一个配送服务实例排在首位，并识别出过量的读取 I/O，这与真实故障情况一致，且无需构建新的 DAG 或合成新的操作符。

In Stage 2, E4 composed a DAG combining span-latency analysis with trace-flow attribution and component-metric evidence. Using only existing operators, it ranked a frontend instance first and identified network latency, matching the ground truth fault.

paragraphs.en: In Bank, an incident flagged increased average service latency. Stages 1 and 2 did not yield a correct diagnosis among the top three leads. E4 identified that its analyses measured metric deviations without considering whether they tracked the affected KPI. In Stage 3, it generated an operator that weights metric anomaly scores by their temporal correlation with the KPI. The resulting DAG ranked the affected application-server instance first, matching the ground truth component.

paragraphs.en: We evaluated E4 on 6 incidents sampled over two weeks from three large-scale production media-streaming services monitored by a large analytics provider. The incidents involved login errors, session errors, search success, and user abandonment. For each incident, we manually established ground truth by identifying the affected user cohort from concentrated complaints in application store reviews. E4 identified the correct cohort in 5 of 6 incidents. Three without additional hints and two with analyst hints guiding operator synthesis or DAG refinement. Among these successful cases, the correct cohort ranked first in three and second in two. We highlight two interesting incidents
paragraphs.zh: 我们从一家大型分析提供商所监控的三个大规模媒体流媒体服务的生产环境中，抽取了为期两周的 6 起事件，并对 E4 进行了评估。 这些事件涉及登录错误、会话错误、搜索成功以及用户放弃操作。 对于每一起事件，我们通过应用商店评论中的集中投诉来识别受影响的用户群体，从而手动确定了基准事实。 E4 在 6 起事件中正确识别出了 5 起事件的目标用户群体。 其中 3 起无需额外提示，另外 2 起则借助了分析师的提示来指导操作符合成或 DAG 优化。 在这些成功案例中，正确目标群体有 3 次排名第一，2 次排名第二。 我们在此重点介绍两起值得关注的案例

paragraphs.en: Observability and monitoring systems RCA relies on diverse telemetry data and business-centric KPIs of interest. There are significant efforts in industry and academia on building such observability, monitoring, and, analytics systems (e.g., [ 46 , 11 , 32 , 30 , 38 , 13 ] ). There are also many anomaly detection techniques built on top of these systems (e.g., [ 64 , 4 , 20 ] ). These efforts are orthogonal to E4 and our system is flexible to accommodate telemetry data from these systems.
paragraphs.zh: 可观察性和监控系统的根本原因分析依赖于多样化的遥测数据以及相关的业务导向型关键绩效指标。 业界和学术界在构建此类可观察性、监控和分析系统方面投入了大量努力（例如，[ 46 , 11 , 32 , 30 , 38 , 13 ]）。 此外，还有许多基于这些系统的异常检测技术（例如，[ 64 , 4 , 20 ]）。 这些工作与 E4 相互独立，且我们的系统能够灵活兼容来自这些系统的遥测数据。

paragraphs.en: Agentic systems for other aspects of operations While we focused on troubleshooting, there are efforts underway to adopt agentic workflows in other aspects of system and network operations (e.g., [ 63 , 71 , 72 ] ). These are orthogonal to our focus, but some of the work on configuration changes could be related both as causes of issues and remediations suggested after RCA. We evaluated works analogous to tool-augmented LLMs [ 61 ] in § 6.4 , however they were significantly outperformed by E4.

paragraphs.en: Optimizing agents An interesting direction for future work is to employ agent optimization techniques [ 1 , 47 , 66 , 40 , 12 ] , including prompt optimization, to improve E4.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体优化 未来工作的一个有趣方向是运用智能体优化技术 [ 1 , 47 , 66 , 40 , 12 ]，包括提示优化，以改进 E4。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead as LLMs improve We expect LLM agents to continue improving, and consider it plausible that generic agents will eventually outperform specialized harnesses in RCA accuracy. For example, on DSB our direct LLM baseline improved from 8 % 8\% accuracy with Gemini-3-Pro to 28 % 28\% with Gemini-3.1-Pro (Figure 6(a) ); even at the latter accuracy it remains approximately 12 × 12\times more expensive than E4. Production RCA will still require efficient execution, explainable results, and low operator effort. E4’s analysis via a DAG of predefined operators avoids excessive token consumption during an incident and also enables reuse of existing pipelines that can be extended across successive investigations. This reduces repeated work while making the diagnosis explainable. As stronger LLMs improve the analysis accuracy, we believe E4 will still provide the mechanisms needed to turn that reasoning into an efficient and explainable operational system.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未来，随着大型语言模型（LLM）的改进，我们预计 LLM 智能体将持续进步，并且认为通用智能体最终在根本原因分析（RCA）准确性方面可能会超越专用工具。 例如，在 DSB 上，我们的直接 LLM 基线模型使用 Gemini-3-Pro 时的准确率为 8%（8\%），而使用 Gemini-3.1-Pro 时则提升至 28%（28\%）（图 6(a)）；即使在后一种准确率下，其成本仍比 E4 高出约 12 倍（12\times）。 生产环境中的 RCA 仍然需要高效的执行、可解释的结果以及较低的操作员工作量。 E4 通过预定义操作符的有向无环图（DAG）进行分析，从而在事件发生时避免过度消耗标记，同时还能复用现有的流程，这些流程可以扩展到连续的多项调查中。 这减少了重复性工作，并使诊断过程具有可解释性。 随着更强大的 LLM 提升了分析准确性，我们相信 E4 仍然能够提供必要的机制，将这些推理转化为一个高效且可解释的运营系统。

paragraphs.en: Data safety Many enterprises may be wary of their data or workflows leaking to frontier models. E4’s design is advantageous in this scenario because the LLM never needs full telemetry dumps: it only sees the incident description, the operator catalog, and the dataset schema whereas the data is accessed locally by the execution engine via E4’s operators.
paragraphs.zh: 数据安全：许多企业可能担心其数据或工作流程会泄露给前沿模型。 在这种情况下，E4 的设计具有优势，因为大型语言模型（LLM）无需获取完整的遥测数据：它仅能看到事件描述、操作符目录和数据集模式，而数据则由执行引擎通过 E4 的操作符在本地访问。

paragraphs.en: Learning improvements An interesting direction of future work is considering a continuously learning version of E4 or using ideas like test-time training [ 59 ] . That is, over time, E4 can build and refine its library of operators, DAG playbooks, and hypothesis exploration prioritization for a given deployment. This could be further augmented with synthetic scenarios and/or human feedback as well.
paragraphs.zh: 学习改进：一个有趣的研究方向是考虑 E4 的持续学习版本，或使用测试时训练 [59] 之类的思路。 也就是说，随着时间的推移，E4 可以为特定的部署构建并完善其算子库、DAG 剧本以及假设探索优先级排序机制。 此外，还可以利用合成场景和/或人类反馈来进一步增强这一功能。

paragraphs.en: Constrained creativity for other Ops tasks E4’s constrained creativity is a promising approach to design agentic systems in various other troubleshooting domains e.g. “grey failures” such as silent packet drops (e.g., [ 28 , 42 ] ), failures in the network layer (e.g., [ 2 , 5 , 57 , 36 , 26 , 18 , 69 , 22 , 3 , 49 ] ), storage systems (e.g., [ 70 ] ), backend infrastructure (e.g., [ 15 , 25 , 73 , 31 , 34 ] ) and large software systems (e.g., [ 68 , 10 ] ). While we focused on RCA, the same idea could also be applied for anomaly detection. We leave these for future work.

paragraphs.en: We presented E4, an agentic RCA system built around constrained creativity: the agent generates a response via a typed dataflow DAG based on domain specific operators for troubleshooting. This approach leads to the agent’s results being accurate, explainable, verifiable and cost-effective. Across a mix of simulated and production workloads, E4 achieves up to 62 % 62\% better accuracy compared to state-of-the-art solutions, while providing more explainable responses at up to 12 × 12\times reduced cost.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 E4，这是一个基于受控创造力的智能体 RCA 系统：该智能体通过一个类型化的数据流 DAG，利用领域特定的故障排除算子生成响应。 这种方法使得智能体的结果具备准确性、可解释性、可验证性和成本效益。 在模拟和实际工作负载的混合测试中，E4 的准确率相比当前最先进的解决方案最高提升了 62%（62\%），同时以高达 12 倍（12\times）更低的成本提供了更具解释性的响应。

paragraphs.en: Workload and collection The fault-injection harness drives the DeathStarBench Social Network backend through simulated client sessions. Sessions carry client attributes and histories and exercise timeline reads and post composition alongside generic client-side URL flows. Each case records a historical window and an anomalous window, followed by fault cleanup and trace collection. Workload settings vary across the saved cases: 22 contain 1,200 sessions and 42 contain 4,800 sessions across the two windows. The runner supports concurrent session generation, with defaults of four workers and ten connections per worker. It collects backend traces from Jaeger [ 30 ] and exports per-container CPU, memory, and disk metrics as spans through Jaeger’s Zipkin endpoint [ 74 ] . The resulting artifact combines request records, session events, traces, resource metrics, and window boundaries, with the injected target recorded as ground truth.
paragraphs.zh: 工作负载与数据收集：故障注入框架通过模拟客户端会话来驱动 DeathStarBench 社交网络的后端。 会话携带客户端属性和历史记录，并执行时间线读取、帖子构建操作，以及通用的客户端 URL 流程。 每个用例都会记录一个历史窗口和一个异常窗口，随后进行故障清理和追踪数据收集。 保存的用例中工作负载设置各不相同：其中 22 个用例包含 1,200 次会话，42 个用例在两个窗口中总共包含 4,800 次会话。 运行器支持并发会话生成，默认配置为四名工作者，每位工作者建立十个连接。 它从 Jaeger [30] 收集后端追踪数据，并通过 Jaeger 的 Zipkin 端点 [74] 以跨度形式导出每个容器的 CPU、内存和磁盘指标。 最终生成的产物结合了请求记录、会话事件、追踪数据、资源指标和窗口边界，其中注入的目标被记录为基准真相。

sents.en: Workload and collection The fault-injection harness drives the DeathStarBench Social Network backend through simulated client sessions.
sents.zh: 工作负载与数据收集：故障注入框架通过模拟客户端会话来驱动 DeathStarBench 社交网络的后端。

sents.en: Sessions carry client attributes and histories and exercise timeline reads and post composition alongside generic client-side URL flows.
sents.zh: 会话携带客户端属性和历史记录，并执行时间线读取、帖子构建操作，以及通用的客户端 URL 流程。

sents.en: Each case records a historical window and an anomalous window, followed by fault cleanup and trace collection.
sents.zh: 每个用例都会记录一个历史窗口和一个异常窗口，随后进行故障清理和追踪数据收集。

sents.en: Workload settings vary across the saved cases: 22 contain 1,200 sessions and 42 contain 4,800 sessions across the two windows.
sents.zh: 保存的用例中工作负载设置各不相同：其中 22 个用例包含 1,200 次会话，42 个用例在两个窗口中总共包含 4,800 次会话。

sents.en: The runner supports concurrent session generation, with defaults of four workers and ten connections per worker.
sents.zh: 运行器支持并发会话生成，默认配置为四名工作者，每位工作者建立十个连接。

sents.en: It collects backend traces from Jaeger [ 30 ] and exports per-container CPU, memory, and disk metrics as spans through Jaeger’s Zipkin endpoint [ 74 ] .
sents.zh: 它从 Jaeger [30] 收集后端追踪数据，并通过 Jaeger 的 Zipkin 端点 [74] 以跨度形式导出每个容器的 CPU、内存和磁盘指标。

sents.en: The resulting artifact combines request records, session events, traces, resource metrics, and window boundaries, with the injected target recorded as ground truth.
sents.zh: 最终生成的产物结合了请求记录、会话事件、追踪数据、资源指标和窗口边界，其中注入的目标被记录为基准真相。

paragraphs.en: Client-side injections Clients carry cohort attributes for country, state, city, ISP, operating system, browser, and application version. For cohort faults, the harness selects an attribute–value pair and applies the fault only to matching clients. Cohort failures return HTTP 503 responses with a sampled probability of 30–80%; cohort-duration faults add 1–5 s to client-observed latency. URL faults affect selected primary or backup URLs in the client flow. History-dependent faults add latency to a client’s second session or fail requests following a selected sequence of events. These predicates require the diagnosis to use session histories in addition to static client attributes.
paragraphs.zh: 客户端注入：客户端携带用于标识国家、州、城市、ISP、操作系统、浏览器和应用程序版本的群体属性。 对于群体故障，测试框架会选择一个属性-值对，并仅对匹配的客户端应用该故障。 群体失败会以 30%–80% 的采样概率返回 HTTP 503 响应；群体持续时长故障会使客户端观测到的延迟增加 1–5 秒。 URL 故障会影响客户端流程中指定的主 URL 或备用 URL。 依赖历史记录的故障会增加客户端第二次会话的延迟，或在选定的事件序列之后使请求失败。 这些谓词要求诊断过程除了使用静态客户端属性外，还必须使用会话历史记录。

paragraphs.en: Backend injections Network faults use tc netem to introduce persistent or intermittent latency at a target service. Resource faults use stress-ng to stress CPU, memory, or disk. Background perturbations on other containers, including confounding resource activity and decoy spikes, make elevated activity alone insufficient to identify the injected target. The 64-case corpus contains 10 persistent-latency cases, four intermittent-latency cases, and six cases for each resource fault. Its remaining 32 cases cover client-side faults: four each for cohort duration and cohort failure, and six each for primary URLs, backup URLs, second-session latency, and event sequences.
paragraphs.zh: 后端注入：网络故障使用 tc netem 在目标服务中引入持续性或间歇性延迟。 资源故障：使用 stress-ng 对 CPU、内存或磁盘进行压力测试。 对其他容器的背景扰动，包括干扰性的资源活动和虚假的峰值，使得仅凭异常高的活动量不足以识别被注入的目标。 该 64 个案例的语料库包含 10 个持续延迟案例、4 个间歇性延迟案例，以及每种资源故障各 6 个案例。 其余 32 个案例涵盖客户端故障：每个类别各有 4 个案例，包括群体持续时间和群体失败；以及各有 6 个案例，包括主 URL、备用 URL、第二会话延迟和事件序列。

paragraphs.en: Preliminaries A deployment exposes telemetry T T : the set of tables its adapter publishes, whose column names are Schema ⁡ ( T ) \mathrm{Schema}(T) . A candidate names a possible root cause, such as a client cohort given by an attribute–value pair, a backend service or host, a URL, or an event pattern. A scored candidate adds a score and the evidence behind it, and a ranked answer is the ordered list of leads returned to the analyst.

paragraphs.en: Evolution solves this by modifying P P and L L alternately. Serving (§ 4.2 ) searches for a program P P over a fixed library L L . When it escalates on incident i i , evolution changes L L by adding operators and playbooks, and serving searches for P P again over the new library. The change to L L is admitted only if serving then satisfies the analyst on i i . Each change is greedy: it is not revisited as later incidents arrive. Bootstrap (§ 4.1 ) only supplies the library this search starts from.
paragraphs.zh: 演化通过交替修改 P P 和 L L 来解决这个问题。 服务（§ 4.2）在固定的库 L L 中搜索程序 P P。 当它在事件 i i 上升级时，演化通过添加操作符和剧本来改变 L L，然后服务会在新的库中再次搜索 P P。 只有当服务随后对事件 i i 令分析师满意时，才会接受对 L L 的更改。 每次更改都是贪婪的：随着后续事件的到来，它不会被重新审视。 引导（§ 4.1）仅提供该搜索所起始的库。
